title: The Song with a Harmony Part Empty
youtube_title: The Song with a Harmony Part Empty | Bedtime Story for Kids in English
moral: Friends can change the plan so both can play.
summary: At a ferry deck with a rail and two elbows of room, Juno is just outside the fun, close to a harmony part nobody had offered to the quiet friend. Farah changes the seating, the rules, or the pace so Juno has a real place, not a prize announced out loud. Neighbor Sami lets the children solve it.
